properties.name: Gyeongbokgung Palace
properties.description: Main royal palace of the Joseon dynasty, aligned with Confucian and geomantic principles. Backed by Bugaksan mountain for protection.

properties.name: Gyeongju — Capital of Silla
properties.description: Ancient capital of the Silla kingdom with royal tombs, Buddhist temples, and the astronomical observatory Cheomseongdae (632 CE).
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, 'museum without walls'

properties.name: Mount Baekdu (Paektu/Changbai)
properties.description: Sacred volcano on the Korean-Chinese border where Hwanung descended from heaven. Contains the heavenly lake Cheonji in its caldera.
